blog.title: Vibe Coding: The Future of Developer Productivity
blog.excerpt: Exploring how natural language interfaces and agentic IDEs are changing how we build software.
blog.content:
Vibe coding is not just about writing code faster; it is about reshaping the cognitive relationship between the developer and their creation.

With agentic IDEs like Windsurf, Devin, and Google AI Studio, developers spend less time wrestling with syntax boilerplate and more time iterating on architecture, user experience, and creative intent.

As a student developer, this shift allows me to build complex applications that previously required large software teams. The key is developing high taste, rapid verification habits, and deep conceptual understanding of the underlying stacks.

blog.title: Balancing Academics and Software Development
blog.excerpt: How I manage my time as a Class 10 student while actively building AI-powered web applications.
blog.content:
Balancing school exams, coursework, and daily software experiments requires intentional time-blocking and focus.

Here are my core strategies:
1. Strict micro-sprints: Focusing on 30-45 minute uninterrupted coding sessions.
2. Building in public: Sharing experiments on CodePen and GitHub forces me to ship clean, finished pieces.
3. Linking learning to projects: Applying computer science concepts directly to real apps.

Discipline turns hobbies into craftsmanship.

blog.title: Building Interactive Experiences with Framer Motion
blog.excerpt: A deep dive into creating buttery-smooth animations and premium micro-interactions in React 19.
blog.content:
Motion on the web should never be gratuitous; it must communicate state, hierarchy, and tactile physical presence.

Using motion/react with reduced-motion awareness ensures every visitor gets an accessible yet visually stunning journey.

In this article, we examine spring physics, layout animations, and custom cursor integrations that elevate digital portfolios to studio caliber.

blog.title: Integrating the Gemini API into Modern Web Apps
blog.excerpt: Practical patterns for leveraging Google's Gemini models to build intelligent, context-aware features.
blog.content:
The Gemini API represents a leap in multimodal understanding and long-context capabilities.

Integrating @google/genai SDK in modern web applications enables real-time reasoning, dynamic content generation, and natural tool calling with minimal latency.

Here is how to structure robust prompt flows and handle streaming responses securely.
